title: IDT xGEN MC Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: This protocol performs the [IDT xGEN MC kit](https://sfvideo.blob.core.windows.net/sitefinity/docs/default-source/protocol/xgen-dna-library-prep-ez-kit-and-xgen-dna-library-prep-ez-uni-kits-protocol.pdf?sfvrsn=57b1e007_8). This protocol uses the stubby adapter (Reagent L3) that is included in the xGEN MC kit during ligation and the barcoding of samples is performed during PCR by using either xGEN UDIs or CDIs. The alternate protocol version is IDT xGEN MC UNI that does the barcoding of samples at ligation instead. The Protocol steps and reagents are different between the two versions. See IDT’s xGEN DNA Library Prep MC Kit protocol for more information about sample barcode kit requirements. The script requires manually transferring the sample plate between the Thermocycler and Magnet 3 times. It starts on the Thermocycler and needs to be moved to the Magnet for the post-ligation cleanup, and then moved to the Thermocycler for PCR and then back to the Magnet for the post-PCR cleanup. NOTE: In the script the two positions are handled as magnetic sample plate and thermocycler sample plate; during calibration, use an empty plate of the same labware as the sample plate on the magnet position to calibrate that position. Explanation of complex parameters below: * `Number of Samples`: Samples are prepared as pictured below; with 100ng of input DNA in 50ul of Low EDTA. See IDT’s xGEN DNA Library Prep EZ Kit protocol for more information about sample input requirements. * `PCR Cycles`: Specify number of PCR cycles if performing PCR on deck. * `Dry Run`: Yes will return tips, skip incubation times, shorten mix, for testing purposes. * `Use Modules?`: Yes will not require modules on the deck and will skip module steps, for testing purposes, if `Dry Run` is set to `Yes`, then this variable will automatically set itself to `No`. * `Reuse Tips?`: No, NYI format for reusing tips * `Use protocol specific z-offsets?`: Sets whether to use protocol specific z offsets for each tip and l
Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Prepare DNA samples
steps.instruction: Aliquot 100 ng of input DNA into 50 µL of Low‑EDTA buffer per sample as illustrated in the kit diagram.

steps.title: Configure protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Enter the number of samples, set the desired number of PCR cycles (if running PCR on‑deck), and choose options: Dry Run (Yes returns tips, skips incubation times, and shortens mixes for testing), Use Modules (Yes skips module steps; automatically set to No if Dry Run is Yes), Reuse Tips (currently not implemented), and Use protocol‑specific z‑offsets (apply the kit‑specific tip offsets).

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol file from the provided link and unzip it if necessary.

steps.title: Upload custom labware
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons App, go to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and upload any required labware JSON files.

steps.title: Upload protocol file
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons App, open the Protocol tab and upload the protocol Python (.py) file.

steps.title: Set up deck
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the provided deck map, placing the sample plate, tip racks, magnetic module, and thermocycler module in their designated slots.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Calibrate the sample plate, tip racks, and pipette using the Opentrons App. For the magnetic module position, calibrate with an empty plate of the same labware as the sample plate.

steps.title: Transfer plate between modules
steps.instruction: Manually move the sample plate three times as the script runs: start on the Thermocycler, transfer to the Magnet for post‑ligation cleanup, return to the Thermocycler for PCR, then move back to the Magnet for post‑PCR cleanup.

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press ‘Run’ in the Opentrons App to execute the protocol.
